Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, August 22, 2019 1:24 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Cc: Bhatia, Peter <pbhatia@gannett.com>
Subject: RE: Statement from MLB 
 
Thanks. I’ve asked for more clarity from MLB. They just admitted a CBA violation but are not willing to take action, which contradicts Section 17 in the Club-Media Regulations document.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Thursday, August 22, 2019 1:19 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Cc: Bhatia, Peter <pbhatia@gannett.com>
Subject: Statement from MLB

MLB Statement: "Per our Club-Media Regulations, the reporter should have been allowed to enter the clubhouse postgame at the same time as the other members of the media. We have communicated this to the Astros."
